passages.name: Line 1
passages.text:
Wilfred: So, it was this Beatrix lady that gave Ackergaul our mother.

[[Line 2]]

passages.name: Line 2
passages.text:
Winifred: She must've been the one to transport me as well. She seems to be in charge of the cargo.

[[Line 3]]

passages.name: Line 3
passages.text:
Wilfred: But Beatrix wasn't the one that took you? She's just another henchman.

[[Line 4]]

passages.name: Line 4
passages.text:
Winifred: Yes. Lionel is the real culprit. Although, I haven't seen or heard from him on my side.

[[Line 5]]

passages.name: Line 6
passages.text:
Wilfred: And even if we do know where this Beatrix lady is, you aren't there! There's no point!

[[Line 7]]

passages.name: Line 7
passages.text:
Winifred: Maybe Beatrix will know where Lionel is? Best to check no?

[[Line 8]]

passages.name: Line 8
passages.text:
Winifred: Unless you have any better suggestions brother.

[[Line 9]]

passages.name: Line 9
passages.text:
Wilfred: *sigh* No. No I don't. Fine! We'll pay Beatrix a little visit.

[[Line 10]]

passages.name: Line 10
passages.text:
Winifred: I'm very sorry I don't have any other suggestions for you, but I guess on the positive side...

[[Line 11]]

passages.name: Line 11
passages.text:
Winifred: If we stop Beatrix, we could prevent a lot of innocent people being killed and transported.

[[Line 12]]

passages.name: Line 12
passages.text:
Wilfred: ...Hmm. You have a point Wini. We've lost a lot of good people to Lionel's group.

[[Line 13]]

passages.name: Line 13
passages.text:
Winifred: Yes. So let's go and stop Beatrix. To find more information on where I am...

[[Line 14]]

passages.name: Line 14
passages.text: Wilfred: And to stop this witch hunting scheme!
